# <span id="aanchor139"></span> Rail Pattern Editor

Rail patterns are datetime effective, allowing the user to set a route and characteristics on a rail pattern for a given period of time. The Rail Pattern Editor is used to create railroad patterns that can be set on tickets where the Transportation Method is set to Rail.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Rail Pattern Editor:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **Liquids** group, **select Rail Pattern Editor**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Rail Pattern Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

- **Route Point** - A location along the rail.
- **Shipper and Product**- Must be set in order to save the Rail Pattern.
- **Shipper, Railroad, Consignee, and Consignor** - Can be created and edited in FLOWCAL’s Company Manager.
- **From and To** - Can be created and edited in FLOWCAL’s Facility Editor.
- **Origin and Destination** - Can be created and edited in FLOWCAL’s Origin and Destination Editor.

</div>
